fact: Analyst-revision drift and failed-revision response plan frozen after schema/boundary feasibility only and before detector scan, targeted pull, or return test.
First frozen-scope 118-symbol news pull was terminated by the four-minute process limit before writing an artifact; no scope or credential failure occurred.

First detector adapter parsed local JSON symbols but not remote native-array symbols, so its January 2, 2025 maximum date proved remote omission before performance. Artifacts preserved under detector_INVALID_array_adapter.
Corrected parsing reached serialization but mixed raw symbol encodings could not share one parquet column.

Corrected detector readiness covered 39,211 scoped single-symbol rows through April 30, 2026 and found 10,545 conservative actions. Frozen audit reviewed 90/90 true detections and 40/40 correct near-miss rejections; this supports precision, not total recall.

Consolidation produced 7,641 point-in-time episodes across 117 symbols after 1,315 same-sign row collapses and 118 conflicting-sign exclusions; 2,469 events are flagged within 36h after earnings. Targeted split daily pull returned 57,239 rows for only those symbols through 2026-04-30 with zero holdout.

Exact event-specific readiness loaded 1,917,936 pre-cutoff minute rows for 5,147 symbol-days. All 7,641 episodes had a market day; 7,116 had exact five-bar reaction and entry paths, 7,094 also cleared shifted $100M liquidity. The 525 exclusions reconcile to 480 incomplete reactions, 40 missing entry minutes, four adjustment/prior-close gaps, and one shifted-liquidity gap.

Frozen 174 source-contract variants across all/standalone scopes, four confirmed/failed long/short legs, nine intraday and four multiday portfolios, five long exits, 5/10/20bp costs, chronological capacity, 10% symbol cap, and 2% short stop.

First output reconciled P&L but audit found floating residual capacity near 7e-17 counted as allocated trades. Artifacts preserved under RUN-0001_INVALID_EPSILON_CAPACITY; economic returns were unaffected.

Corrected 174/174 baseline passed command/config/code/data/output reconciliation, zero holdout, independent P&L and exposure checks. The only invalid-to-valid numeric change was allocated count (max nine). Best central 10bp all-long ten-session book averaged 1.7424% per month over 15 months with 16.38% drawdown, 34-day recovery, 10 positive and five negative months; all intraday portfolios lost.

Frozen 720 long-mechanism diagnostic variants: three portfolios, 40 causal screens spanning action/clock/reaction/participation/gap/repetition/shifted stock and QQQ state, three exits, and 10/20bp costs at unchanged 2% sizing.

The first invocation stopped before simulation because the stock-state join asserted one-to-one while multiple analyst episodes may share a symbol-day. No result artifact was produced and no strategy evidence was interpreted.

The second invocation stopped before artifact writing when missing QQQ dates coerced a high-volatility flag and unary boolean inversion failed. Partial in-memory variants were discarded and not interpreted.

The third invocation completed the grid but stopped before writing because 24 cash-only zero-event variants were absent from trade groupby totals while present in all 720 zero-P&L daily series. No performance was interpreted.

Final 720/720 run reconciled with zero holdout. Best high-stock-vol all-long ten-day screen averaged 1.7511% per recent month at 10bp, 9.84% drawdown, 24-day recovery, 10 positive/five negative months, 110 symbols, four positive blocks; the parent was nearly tied at 1.7424%, and no screen reached 1.8%.

Frozen 336 variants across three long portfolios, seven broad/interpretable screens, five/ten-day exits, 10/20bp costs, and 2%, 3.33%, 5%, 10% event caps under unchanged unit gross and 10% symbol limits.

All 336 variants reconciled with zero holdout. Highest recent return was 2.8264% monthly but had 22.67% drawdown and a negative first block. The smoother gap-down 5% cap neighbor averaged 2.3143% with 16.91% drawdown, 11 positive/four negative months, 100 symbols and four positive blocks. No variant reached 3%.

Frozen 576 variants across completed 1/5/15/30-minute reactions, 0/1/3/5-minute entry latency, three long portfolios, five/ten-day exits, 10/20bp costs, and 2%/5%/10% caps. Comparable 5-minute zero-latency cells must exactly reproduce RUN-0003.
The first invocation exceeded the 10-minute foreground limit and was terminated before any output artifact was written or result interpreted.

All 576 variants and 36 exact parent reproductions passed with zero holdout. Best combined 15-minute neighborhood reached 2.6672% recent average month but had six negative months. Failed-negative one-minute reaction with three/five-minute delay reached 2.6337%/2.5935%, 11 positive/four negative months and 17%-18% drawdown; 30-minute neighbors were similar. No cell approached Type A.

Frozen exact validation of fast/slow failed-negative and combined midwindow profiles: all-symbol plus top/bottom firm/event/day capacity-aware removals, 20,000 three-month-block samples, rolling windows, concentration, and matched 20bp costs.

Three profiles reproduced exactly; 439 capacity-aware removals and 20,000 block samples per profile/window passed with zero holdout. Worst removals stayed near 2.0%-2.5% monthly, but every profile had 0/20,000 recent samples at 10%; recent 95th percentiles were 4.27%-4.62%.
